items.label: 3 in 1 Wireless Charger Station
items.value: Is the ultimate 3-in-1 charging solution for all Apple devices and other models.Simultaneously charge your iPhone, Apple Watch and Air Pods, with a quick 2.5-3 hour full charge to meet all your charging needs at once (Note: (mobile phone case try not to exceed the thickness of more than 2mm to avoid charging).

items.label: Wide compatibility
items.value: Wireless charger phone charging position without magnetic suction function for iPhone 17/16/15/14/13/13/12/11/12Mini/Pro/Pro Max/XS/XR/XS MAX/X/8/Plus/watch and headphones only support i Phone models iWatch 10/9/8/7/6/5/4/iWatch. 3/2/SE/Ultra/Ultra 2 and Air Pods 2/3/4/Pro/Pro 2 ,for And-roid/Samsung series (Headset model: Galaxy Buds series；Galaxy Watch4 Smartwatch ;Samsung mobile phones (Galaxy S series: Galaxy S24/S23/S22/S21 series) (Note: only supports wireless charging devices; Air Pods are only compatible with wireless charging cases).

items.label: Portable Folding Design
items.value: Apple charging station with foldable and lightweight design, can charge up to 3 devices at the same time, non-slip surface ensures that your device stays in place during charging, ideal for home, office, travelling, it provides fast and reliable power supply, easy to put in your bag, i Phone wireless charger say goodbye to clutter and hello to efficiency. A thoughtful gift for your loved ones/friends.

items.label: On/Off Indicator light
items.value: The charging station provides adjustable ambient lighting. When the device is placed on a wireless charger, the green light of the indicator light will turn on, and after 3 seconds, the blue light will turn on for charging. At night, touch the switch to control the light, and there will be no light disturbance when sleeping. If it flashes, it indicates abnormal charging; Please check for any foreign objects or incorrect positions.

items.label: Multiple Protection of Wireless Charger
items.value: The wireless charger is F-CC certified with overcharge, overvoltage, overheat protection and foreign object detection. The back of the charging station is also equipped with cooling holes, which can quickly dissipate heat and effectively improve the charging efficiency, equipped with an 18W fast charger adapter, which can protect your device from overcharging damage and ensure charging safety.

items.label: Travel Portable
items.value: It is made of ABS fireproof material, the temperature will stay below 104 degrees Fahrenheit when charging; Smoothly folds 180°, high-end compact appearance is easy to carry, suitable for home, office, travelling and any occasions.

items.label: What You Will Get
items.value: Wireless Charger; User Manual; 18W Charging Cable QC 3.0 fast power adapter
